disposition_reason: Animal brain synchrotron XRF study; relative differences and LOD only; absolute values only in a figure; no food or human data.

study.design: animal study, diet-induced obesity versus lean controls
study.method: synchrotron radiation X-ray fluorescence (SOLARIS POLYX beamline)

non_numeric_findings: Brain rubidium about 35 to 72% higher in obese rats across nine regions (Results, p. 5).
Authors state the obese rats had lower dietary rubidium intake, citing their earlier study (Introduction, p. 2).
